title: Evaluating Medical LLMs by Levels of Autonomy: A Survey Moving from Benchmarks to Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying literature that utilizes counterfactual tests in clinical triage scenarios to reveal intersectional performance differences across patient subgroups.

bias_targets.target: Prompt and Formatting bias (Anchoring, Sycophancy, Option-order)
bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing studies that measure output shifts and systematic tendencies when applying small, meaning-preserving prompt changes, option-order swapping in multiple-choice questions, and early anchoring hints.

Highlighting evaluation frameworks that use pairwise preferences and rubric-based scores, while controlling for inherent model biases through order randomization, blinding positions, and style/length normalization.
